name: omokawa-skills
description: Plan-driven development workflow を構成する個別 skill 群。必要なものだけ install 可能

plugins.name: define-acceptance-criteria
plugins.description: Use when a plan needs acceptance criteria before MECE review; skip throwaway PoC validation.

plugins.name: mece-plan-review
plugins.description: Use after acceptance criteria exist to check specification and code coverage, update the analysis, and update one plan quality-summary line before implementation.

plugins.name: finalize-plan
plugins.description: Use after a plan's acceptance criteria and MECE analysis are complete, immediately before implementation.

plugins.name: review-design
plugins.description: Use before adding a feature, file, module, interface, or seam, or when deciding where code should live; always use for auth, billing, payment, migration, or security changes.

plugins.name: apply-findings
plugins.description: Use after code review or before committing to apply mechanically safe findings and report judgment calls; use review-only for no-edit or another-PR inspection.

plugins.name: model-data
plugins.description: 要求文書からDBML形式のER図を生成し、SQLアンチパターンを検出。

plugins.name: map-user-stories
plugins.description: Use when a design, specification, Jira epic, page, or supplied text must become an implementation-ready user story map and delivery plan.

plugins.name: qa-ui
plugins.description: Use to verify implemented UI. With QA-ID instructions, manual handoff is default and a missing ledger file is initialized. Browser automation requires explicit opt-in unless no QA-ID source exists and fallback is required.

plugins.name: create-jira-issues
plugins.description: ユーザーストーリーマップやタスク分解プランからJiraチケットを一括作成。

plugins.name: set-jira-story-points
plugins.description: JiraキーとStory Pointsのマップから一括でStory Pointsを設定する。

plugins.name: translate-to-vision-story
plugins.description: プロジェクト活動をビジョン整合した Zenn 記事下書きに翻訳。

plugins.name: dry-ssot-text
plugins.description: Use when reader-facing prose or code-comment explanations repeat across a document or change set; not for code structure or logic duplication.

plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: カレントブランチのConventional Commits PRを作成・更新する。既定draft、明示時のみready。

plugins.name: purge-private-vocab
plugins.description: Use when reader-facing text or plans contain plan-local coinages, abbreviations, layer labels, or finding IDs that may be opaque without their source plan.

plugins.name: express-intent-in-code
plugins.description: Use when a redundancy guard reports comments, suppressions, or sibling files; before adding a helper; or when reviewing abstraction names and cohesion.

plugins.name: extract-figma-spec
plugins.description: Use before or during Figma-driven implementation to extract returned design properties into atomized checks, compare them with code, and write a canonical results table.

plugins.name: build-poc
plugins.description: PoC、実現可能性の検証、技術比較、gdocs 案件の初期化または PRD 凍結を依頼されたときに使用。

plugins.name: build-prototype
plugins.description: PoC を既存コードベースの慣習に合わせたプロトタイプへ書き直すときに使用。

plugins.name: create-design-doc
plugins.description: 案件プランと取得可能なプロトタイプから DD (Design Doc) を作るときに使用。
